s0201.literal: Ningxia Route wanhu office and Qingyuan Pacification Commission suffered famine; both were granted relief.
s0201.idiomatic: Ningxia Route wanhu office and Qingyuan Pacification Commission suffered famine; both were granted relief.

s0202.literal: The liquor prohibition in Ningxia Route was relaxed.
s0202.idiomatic: The liquor prohibition in Ningxia Route was relaxed.

s0203.literal: Pacification commissioners Ma He [some] and Li Rang impeached Zhejiang-West surveillance commissioner Wanzhibuhua for accepting bribes; on ledger verification he did not confess; an edict dispatched Ministry of Justice bureau director Suozhu to investigate his insulting of envoys, and he was flogged.
s0203.idiomatic: Pacification commissioners Ma He [some] and Li Rang impeached Zhejiang-West surveillance commissioner Wanzhibuhua for accepting bribes; on ledger verification he did not confess; an edict dispatched Ministry of Justice bureau director Suozhu to investigate his insulting of envoys, and he was flogged.

s0204.literal: Prince Busaiyin dispatched envoys presenting a tiger.
s0204.idiomatic: Prince Busaiyin dispatched envoys presenting a tiger.

s0205.literal: Eleventh month, on guimao day central secretariat officials said: "Western monks each use birth-anniversary memorials to secure release of serious prisoners, contrary to proper governance; we request this be abolished.
s0205.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on guimao day central secretariat officials said: "Western monks each use birth-anniversary memorials to secure release of serious prisoners, contrary to proper governance; we request this be abolished.

s0206.literal: " An edict directed: "From now on, those who are to be released shall be reviewed by the Court of the Imperial Clan.
s0206.idiomatic: " An edict directed: "From now on, those who are to be released shall be reviewed by the Court of the Imperial Clan.

s0207.literal: " On yisi day Prince of Liang Wang Chan proceeded to the northern frontier; two thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0207.idiomatic: " On yisi day Prince of Liang Wang Chan proceeded to the northern frontier; 2,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0208.literal: On jiyou day a deer-peak palm-fiber pavilion was built.
s0208.idiomatic: On jiyou day a deer-peak palm-fiber pavilion was built.

s0209.literal: On xinhai day former central secretariat grand councillor Li Meng's office was posthumously restored.
s0209.idiomatic: On xinhai day former central secretariat grand councillor Li Meng's office was posthumously restored.

s0210.literal: Prince of Xiangning Bala Temür was granted three thousand ingots of notes.
s0210.idiomatic: Prince of Xiangning Bala Temür was granted 3,000 ingots of notes.

s0211.literal: Prince Busaiyin dispatched envoys presenting horses.
s0211.idiomatic: Prince Busaiyin dispatched envoys presenting horses.

s0212.literal: On yimao day Venus encroached upon Jianbi.
s0212.idiomatic: On yimao day Venus encroached upon Jianbi.

s0213.literal: Toujiang Tuan Yao in Guangxi raided; pacification commissioner Mainu induced them to submit.
s0213.idiomatic: Toujiang Tuan Yao in Guangxi raided; pacification commissioner Mainu induced them to submit.

s0214.literal: Fuling, Qingxi, Litou and other Yuan barbarians raided; the Huguang branch secretariat dispatched envoys to induce them to submit.
s0214.idiomatic: Fuling, Qingxi, Litou and other Yuan barbarians raided; the Huguang branch secretariat dispatched envoys to induce them to submit.

s0215.literal: On wuwu day one hundred thousand ingots each of Zhongtong and Zhiyuan notes were minted.
s0215.idiomatic: On wuwu day 100,000 ingots each of Zhongtong and Zhiyuan notes were minted.

s0216.literal: Prince Temür Buqa was enfeoffed Prince of Zhennan to garrison Yangzhou.
s0216.idiomatic: Prince Temür Buqa was enfeoffed Prince of Zhennan to garrison Yangzhou.

s0217.literal: On xinyou day censor-in-chief Niuzhe was additionally granted commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies.
s0217.idiomatic: On xinyou day censor-in-chief Niuzhe was additionally granted commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies.

s0218.literal: The Lu-ling River god was posthumously enfeoffed as Xianying.
s0218.idiomatic: The Lu-ling River god was posthumously enfeoffed as Xianying.

s0219.literal: The liquor prohibition in Chengdu was relaxed.
s0219.idiomatic: The liquor prohibition in Chengdu was relaxed.

s0220.literal: Bozhou barbarian Song Wangbao came to submit.
s0220.idiomatic: Bozhou barbarian Song Wangbao came to submit.

s0221.literal: On jisi day Shangdu's Qingning Hall was relocated to the Bo'er travel-palace.
s0221.idiomatic: On jisi day Shangdu's Qingning Hall was relocated to the Bo'er travel-palace.

s0222.literal: The prohibition on mountains and marshes in Yongping Route was relaxed.
s0222.idiomatic: The prohibition on mountains and marshes in Yongping Route was relaxed.

s0223.literal: Tibetan barbarians of Jie Prefecture raided; the Martial and Tranquil King dispatched Lintao Route commander Zhanzhan to induce them to submit.
s0223.idiomatic: Tibetan barbarians of Jie Prefecture raided; the Martial and Tranquil King dispatched Lintao Route commander Zhanzhan to induce them to submit.

s0224.literal: Subordinate counties of Guangning Route suffered protracted rains that harmed the crops; thirty thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief.
s0224.idiomatic: Subordinate counties of Guangning Route suffered protracted rains that harmed the crops; 30,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

s0225.literal: Mianyang Prefecture suffered drought; its tax was remitted.
s0225.idiomatic: Mianyang Prefecture suffered drought; its tax was remitted.

s0226.literal: Yongping Route suffered great flooding; its land tax was remitted and grain relief was granted for four months.
s0226.idiomatic: Yongping Route suffered great flooding; its land tax was remitted and grain relief was granted for 4 months.

s0227.literal: Bianliang, Jiankang, Taiping, Chizhou and other routes and Gansu's Yijina'i Route suffered famine; all were granted relief.
s0227.idiomatic: Bianliang, Jiankang, Taiping, Chizhou and other routes and Gansu's Yijina'i Route suffered famine; all were granted relief.

s0228.literal: Jin Prefecture's waters overflowed, ruining one thousand qing of fields and drowning one hundred people; one ingot of notes was granted per person.
s0228.idiomatic: Jin Prefecture's waters overflowed, ruining 1,000 qing of fields and drowning 100 people; 1 ingot of notes was granted per person.

s0229.literal: Chongming Prefecture's sea overflowed, washing away five hundred households; grain relief was granted for one month and twenty strings of notes per deceased.
s0229.idiomatic: Chongming Prefecture's sea overflowed, washing away 500 households; grain relief was granted for 1 month and 20 strings of notes per deceased.

s0230.literal: Twelfth month, on dingchou day Prince Yuesibie presented a literary leopard; gold, silver, notes, and silks were granted in varying amounts.
s0230.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on dingchou day Prince Yuesibie presented a literary leopard; gold, silver, notes, and silks were granted in varying amounts.

s0231.literal: Censor Hala Nuhai requested selecting upright men to tutor the crown prince; the Emperor praised and accepted it.
s0231.idiomatic: Censor Hala Nuhai requested selecting upright men to tutor the crown prince; the Emperor praised and accepted it.

s0232.literal: On renwu day censor Jia Xu requested enshrining Empress Wuzong in the Grand Ancestral Temple — no response.
s0232.idiomatic: On renwu day censor Jia Xu requested enshrining Empress Wuzong in the Grand Ancestral Temple — no response.

s0233.literal: An edict directed that next year on Lantern Festival a lamp-mountain be built within the inner court; censor Zhao Shilu requested its cancellation because of flood and drought — approved.
s0233.idiomatic: An edict directed that next year on Lantern Festival a lamp-mountain be built within the inner court; censor Zhao Shilu requested its cancellation because of flood and drought — approved.

s0234.literal: On jiashen day Shilu again requested the Emperor personally sacrifice at the suburban altars and ancestral temple; the Emperor praised and accepted it.
s0234.idiomatic: On jiashen day Shilu again requested the Emperor personally sacrifice at the suburban altars and ancestral temple; the Emperor praised and accepted it.

s0235.literal: On bingxu day, because Muslim yin-yang masters spoke of celestial changes, two thousand ingots of notes were distributed to virtuous practitioners and beggars and to imprisoned persons, to avert calamity.
s0235.idiomatic: On bingxu day, because Muslim yin-yang masters spoke of celestial changes, 2,000 ingots of notes were distributed to virtuous practitioners and beggars and to imprisoned persons, to avert calamity.

s0236.literal: On dinghai day Ningxia Route suffered earthquake with sound like thunder, shaking four times in succession.
s0236.idiomatic: On dinghai day Ningxia Route suffered earthquake with sound like thunder, shaking 4 times in succession.

s0237.literal: On gengyin day amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
s0237.idiomatic: On gengyin day amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

s0238.literal: Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat right vice director Zhao Jian was summoned as Hall of Worthies grand academician to head the classics colloquium.
s0238.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat right vice director Zhao Jian was summoned as Hall of Worthies grand academician to head the classics colloquium.

s0239.literal: On renchen day gold and silver banquet vessels were granted to Prince of Liang Wang Chan.
s0239.idiomatic: On renchen day gold and silver banquet vessels were granted to Prince of Liang Wang Chan.

s0240.literal: Because the imperial son Xiaoxue cried at night, notes were granted to the elderly.
s0240.idiomatic: Because the imperial son Xiaoxue cried at night, notes were granted to the elderly.

s0241.literal: On guisi day the Deer-Peak Hall was built.
s0241.idiomatic: On guisi day the Deer-Peak Hall was built.

s0242.literal: On jihai day the Imperial Preceptor was ordered to perform Buddhist rites and release three serious prisoners.
s0242.idiomatic: On jihai day the Imperial Preceptor was ordered to perform Buddhist rites and release 3 serious prisoners.

s0243.literal: The Dacheng Hua Puqing Temple chief steward's office was established; the Guiyun transport intendant's office was abolished.
s0243.idiomatic: The Dacheng Hua Puqing Temple chief steward's office was established; the Guiyun transport intendant's office was abolished.

s0244.literal: Censors said: "In recent years construction projects have used guard troops for corvée labor, neglecting military training.
s0244.idiomatic: Censors said: "In recent years construction projects have used guard troops for corvée labor, neglecting military training.

s0245.literal: We request following Emperor Shizu's old system in drilling the Five Guards' personal troops, for escort duty.
s0245.idiomatic: We request following Emperor Shizu's old system in drilling the Five Guards' personal troops, for escort duty.

s0247.literal: Huguang garrison thousand-household Zhigan Buhua induced Fuling Cave barbarian Liu Ji and others to submit.
s0247.idiomatic: Huguang garrison thousand-household Zhigan Buhua induced Fuling Cave barbarian Liu Ji and others to submit.

s0248.literal: Baoding Route suffered famine; eighty-one thousand five hundred shi of grain were granted in relief.
s0248.idiomatic: Baoding Route suffered famine; 81,500 shi of grain were granted in relief.

s0249.literal: Huaqing Route suffered famine; forty thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief.
s0249.idiomatic: Huaqing Route suffered famine; 40,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

s0250.literal: Boz Prefecture's river overflowed, washing away more than eight hundred households, ruining two thousand three hundred qing of fields; the land tax was remitted.
s0250.idiomatic: Boz Prefecture's river overflowed, washing away more than 800 households, ruining 2,300 qing of fields; the land tax was remitted.

s0251.literal: Guangxi's Jingjiang, Xiang Prefecture and other routes and Liaoyang Route suffered famine; all were granted relief.
s0251.idiomatic: Guangxi's Jingjiang, Xiang Prefecture and other routes and Liaoyang Route suffered famine; all were granted relief.

s0252.literal: Daning Route suffered great flooding, ruining five thousand five hundred qing of fields and washing away more than eight hundred households; one ingot of notes was granted per drowned person.
s0252.idiomatic: Daning Route suffered great flooding, ruining 5,500 qing of fields and washing away more than 800 households; 1 ingot of notes was granted per drowned person.

s0253.literal: Fourth year, first month, on jiachen day Prince Mainu came to court; he was granted one ingot of gold, ten ingots of silver, two thousand ingots of notes, and forty bolts each of silks.
s0253.idiomatic: Fourth year, first month, on jiachen day Prince Mainu came to court; he was granted 1 ingot of gold, 10 ingots of silver, 2,000 ingots of notes, and 40 bolts each of silks.

s0254.literal: On yisi day the Censorate requested the Emperor personally sacrifice at the suburban altars and ancestral temple; the Emperor said: "We follow Emperor Shizu's old system; let great ministers officiate by proxy.
s0254.idiomatic: On yisi day the Censorate requested the Emperor personally sacrifice at the suburban altars and ancestral temple; the Emperor said: "We follow Emperor Shizu's old system; let great ministers officiate by proxy.

s0255.literal: " On jiwei day Venus encroached upon Ox.
s0255.idiomatic: " On jiwei day Venus encroached upon Ox.

s0256.literal: On gengxu day the Shaoxing Route Shimen Ten Stockades inspection office was established; censor Xin Jun said: "Western merchants peddling jewels often spend tens of thousands of ingots of notes; now with flood and drought the people are impoverished — we request curtailing this expenditure.
s0256.idiomatic: On gengxu day the Shaoxing Route Shimen Ten Stockades inspection office was established; censor Xin Jun said: "Western merchants peddling jewels often spend tens of thousands of ingots of notes; now with flood and drought the people are impoverished — we request curtailing this expenditure.

s0258.literal: On renzi day the Central Palace's gold, silver, and iron smelters were returned to the central secretariat.
s0258.idiomatic: On renzi day the Central Palace's gold, silver, and iron smelters were returned to the central secretariat.

s0259.literal: Prince of Jing'an Kuo Buhua proceeded to garrison Shaanxi; two thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0259.idiomatic: Prince of Jing'an Kuo Buhua proceeded to garrison Shaanxi; 2,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0260.literal: On guichou day Princes Alatenashili and others were granted six thousand ingots of notes.
s0260.idiomatic: On guichou day Princes Alatenashili and others were granted 6,000 ingots of notes.

s0261.literal: On jiayin day falconer Toto'er fell ill; one thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0261.idiomatic: On jiayin day falconer Toto'er fell ill; 1,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0262.literal: On wuwu day purchase of pearl and jewel ornaments was ordered.
s0262.idiomatic: On wuwu day purchase of pearl and jewel ornaments was ordered.

s0263.literal: On gengshen day imperial son Yundan Zangbu received Buddhist precepts at Zhi Spring Temple.
s0263.idiomatic: On gengshen day imperial son Yundan Zangbu received Buddhist precepts at Zhi Spring Temple.

s0264.literal: Yanguan Prefecture's sea waters overflowed, ruining more than two thousand paces of sea-dike.
s0264.idiomatic: Yanguan Prefecture's sea waters overflowed, ruining more than 2,000 paces of sea-dike.

s0265.literal: On jiazi day Wulong Cave barbarians raided fortresses of Wuyuan County.
s0265.idiomatic: On jiazi day Wulong Cave barbarians raided fortresses of Wuyuan County.

s0266.literal: On dingmao day Yan South surveillance commission requested establishing a Changping granary in Zhending; no response.
s0266.idiomatic: On dingmao day Yan South surveillance commission requested establishing a Changping granary in Zhending; no response.

s0267.literal: The Huitong Canal was dredged and the Huozhou granary-protection dike was built, employing thirty thousand corvée laborers.
s0267.idiomatic: The Huitong Canal was dredged and the Huozhou granary-protection dike was built, employing 30,000 corvée laborers.

s0268.literal: The verifying officer of the Yunnan branch secretariat was established for the first time.
s0268.idiomatic: The verifying officer of the Yunnan branch secretariat was established for the first time.

s0269.literal: Various commanderies of the Liaoyang branch secretariat suffered famine; one hundred eighty thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief.
s0269.idiomatic: Various commanderies of the Liaoyang branch secretariat suffered famine; 180,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

s0270.literal: Zhangde, Huai'an, Yangzhou and other routes suffered famine; all were granted relief.
s0270.idiomatic: Zhangde, Huai'an, Yangzhou and other routes suffered famine; all were granted relief.

s0271.literal: Daning Route suffered flooding; one ingot of notes was granted per drowned person.
s0271.idiomatic: Daning Route suffered flooding; 1 ingot of notes was granted per drowned person.

s0272.literal: Second month, on xinwei day the former agriculturist was sacrificed to.
s0272.idiomatic: Second month, on xinwei day the former agriculturist was sacrificed to.

s0273.literal: On jiaxu day the spirit portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong were sacrificed to at Dacheng Hua Puqing Temple, with Hanlin Academy officials officiating.
s0273.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the spirit portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong were sacrificed to at Dacheng Hua Puqing Temple, with Hanlin Academy officials officiating.

s0274.literal: On yihai day imperial prince Yesen Temür proceeded to garrison the northern frontier; he was granted one ingot of gold, five ingots of silver, five hundred ingots of notes, and ten bolts each of silks.
s0274.idiomatic: On yihai day imperial prince Yesen Temür proceeded to garrison the northern frontier; he was granted 1 ingot of gold, 5 ingots of silver, 500 ingots of notes, and 10 bolts each of silks.

s0275.literal: On bingzi day Yiliechi was ordered to take charge of Renzong's spirit hall; grand steward Yilianzhen Kirisi was made darughachi of the Dacheng Hua Puqing Temple chief steward's office, remaining grand steward.
s0275.idiomatic: On bingzi day Yiliechi was ordered to take charge of Renzong's spirit hall; grand steward Yilianzhen Kirisi was made darughachi of the Dacheng Hua Puqing Temple chief steward's office, remaining grand steward.

s0276.literal: On renwu day the Emperor hunted at Huozhou.
s0276.idiomatic: On renwu day the Emperor hunted at Huozhou.

s0277.literal: Princes Huosha, Herong, and Dali proceeded to garrison the northern frontier; gold, silver, notes, and silks were granted in varying amounts.
s0277.idiomatic: Princes Huosha, Herong, and Dali proceeded to garrison the northern frontier; gold, silver, notes, and silks were granted in varying amounts.

s0278.literal: The Imperial Preceptor Sakya Yeshe Gyaltsen Changba Yeshe Odzer died; Tash Temür and Niuzhe were ordered to supervise Buddhist rites.
s0278.idiomatic: The Imperial Preceptor Sakya Yeshe Gyaltsen Changba Yeshe Odzer died; Tash Temür and Niuzhe were ordered to supervise Buddhist rites.

s0279.literal: On bingxu day associate privy council administrator Yan Temür was ordered to drill the guard armies.
s0279.idiomatic: On bingxu day associate privy council administrator Yan Temür was ordered to drill the guard armies.

s0280.literal: On wuzi day hereditary Yansheng Duke Kong Sihui was promoted to the rank of Jiayi dafu.
s0280.idiomatic: On wuzi day hereditary Yansheng Duke Kong Sihui was promoted to the rank of Jiayi dafu.

s0281.literal: Masihu was made Yunnan branch secretariat grand councillor, supervising Wumeng garrison agriculture.
s0281.idiomatic: Masihu was made Yunnan branch secretariat grand councillor, supervising Wumeng garrison agriculture.

s0282.literal: On gengyin day the chieftain Zhaonantong of the Eight Hundred Wives barbarians came to present tribute goods.
s0282.idiomatic: On gengyin day the chieftain Zhaonantong of the Eight Hundred Wives barbarians came to present tribute goods.

s0283.literal: On xinmao day a white rainbow pierced the sun; the Palace Provision chief steward's office and the Cloud-Requisition chief steward's office were subordinated to the Shangdu commissioner for custody.
s0283.idiomatic: On xinmao day a white rainbow pierced the sun; the Palace Provision chief steward's office and the Cloud-Requisition chief steward's office were subordinated to the Shangdu commissioner for custody.

s0284.literal: Fengyuan, Luzhou, Huai'an and other routes and the Baideng tribe suffered famine; grain relief was granted in varying amounts.
s0284.idiomatic: Fengyuan, Luzhou, Huai'an and other routes and the Baideng tribe suffered famine; grain relief was granted in varying amounts.

s0285.literal: Yongping Route suffered famine; thirty thousand ingots of notes and two months' grain were granted in relief.
s0285.idiomatic: Yongping Route suffered famine; 30,000 ingots of notes and 2 months' grain were granted in relief.

s0286.literal: Third month, on xinchou day imperial son Yundan Zangbu proceeded to garrison the northern frontier.
s0286.idiomatic: Third month, on xinchou day imperial son Yundan Zangbu proceeded to garrison the northern frontier.

s0287.literal: Naghai Chi was made Duke of Hui State and deliberated Inner Secretariat affairs.
s0287.idiomatic: Naghai Chi was made Duke of Hui State and deliberated Inner Secretariat affairs.

s0288.literal: On guimao day Hening suffered earthquake with sound like thunder.
s0288.idiomatic: On guimao day Hening suffered earthquake with sound like thunder.

s0289.literal: On bingwu day eighty-five jinshi examinees including Achachi and Li Fu passed the palace examination; jinshi with honors and with regular passes were granted in varying ranks.
s0289.idiomatic: On bingwu day 85 jinshi examinees including Achachi and Li Fu passed the palace examination; jinshi with honors and with regular passes were granted in varying ranks.

s0290.literal: Western monks were ordered to perform wind-stilling Buddhist rites.
s0290.idiomatic: Western monks were ordered to perform wind-stilling Buddhist rites.

s0291.literal: Chaozhou Route judge Qian Zhen harassed and assaulted the wife Liu of assistant magistrate Liang Qi; when she refused, he falsely charged Liang and imprisoned and killed him.
s0291.idiomatic: Chaozhou Route judge Qian Zhen harassed and assaulted the wife Liu of assistant magistrate Liang Qi; when she refused, he falsely charged Liang and imprisoned and killed him.

s0292.literal: When the matter came to light, Zhen took poison and died; an edict ordered his corpse dismembered and the head displayed.
s0292.idiomatic: When the matter came to light, Zhen took poison and died; an edict ordered his corpse dismembered and the head displayed.

s0293.literal: Haibei surveillance vice commissioner Liu Anren was stripped of office for accepting Zhen's bribes.
s0293.idiomatic: Haibei surveillance vice commissioner Liu Anren was stripped of office for accepting Zhen's bribes.

s0294.literal: On xinhai day Princes Shuosiban, Busaiyi, and others came to present literary leopards, western horses, girdle swords, pearls, jewels, and other goods; gold and notes were granted by the ten-thousands.
s0294.idiomatic: On xinhai day Princes Shuosiban, Busaiyi, and others came to present literary leopards, western horses, girdle swords, pearls, jewels, and other goods; gold and notes were granted by the ten-thousands.

s0295.literal: On gengshen day envoys were dispatched to the Jiangnan region to seek rare flowers and exotic fruits.
s0295.idiomatic: On gengshen day envoys were dispatched to the Jiangnan region to seek rare flowers and exotic fruits.

s0296.literal: On xinyou day grand preceptor Duotai was made grand tutor, grand guardian Tuhulu was made grand preceptor, and yeke jarquchi Botash was made grand guardian.
s0296.idiomatic: On xinyou day grand preceptor Duotai was made grand tutor, grand guardian Tuhulu was made grand preceptor, and yeke jarquchi Botash was made grand guardian.

s0297.literal: An edict directed former grand tutor Boghu to deliberate great affairs and receive his stipend for life.
s0297.idiomatic: An edict directed former grand tutor Boghu to deliberate great affairs and receive his stipend for life.

s0298.literal: Hanlin academician-director Duke of Cai State Zhang Gui, Hall of Worthies grand academician Lian Xun, and crown prince mentor Wang Yi were all restored to their former offices; Shaanxi branch censorate vice director Jing Yan was made Hall of Worthies grand academician; all deliberated central secretariat affairs — Gui still attended the classics colloquium.
s0298.idiomatic: Hanlin academician-director Duke of Cai State Zhang Gui, Hall of Worthies grand academician Lian Xun, and crown prince mentor Wang Yi were all restored to their former offices; Shaanxi branch censorate vice director Jing Yan was made Hall of Worthies grand academician; all deliberated central secretariat affairs — Gui still attended the classics colloquium.

s0299.literal: Prince Huosha's division was granted four thousand ingots of notes.
s0299.idiomatic: Prince Huosha's division was granted 4,000 ingots of notes.

s0300.literal: Commandery kings Duolai, Ulugu, and others' divisions suffered livestock disaster; thirty-five thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief.
s0300.idiomatic: Commandery kings Duolai, Ulugu, and others' divisions suffered livestock disaster; 35,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.
